articles.title: Fed policymakers focused on inflation risks in October, with some seeing need for bigger rate hike
articles.desc: Federal Reserve officials noted a greater risk of inflation requiring more action during their October meeting. Although they decided to keep interest rates steady, discussions indicated a potential need for a half-percentage-point increase. Policymakers expressed concerns over persistent inflation that might not ease quickly enough. The forthcoming December meeting could see intense debates on potential rate hikes and policy adjustments.

articles.desc: Indian equity benchmarks declined amid weak global cues and profit booking, with the Nifty falling 0.63% and Sensex 0.61%. Choice Broking's Sachin Gupta recommended three stocks—Vijaya, Eureka Forbes and Deepak Fertilisers—with bullish technical setups and defined targets.

articles.title: Dalmia Bharat to consider share buyback at Nov 23 board meeting
articles.desc: Dalmia Bharat, India's fourth-largest cement manufacturer, will hold a board meeting on November 23. The meeting will focus on a proposal for a buyback of fully paid-up equity shares. Specific details regarding the buyback size, price, and number of shares have not been disclosed yet. The company also plans to expand its cement capacity to 75 million tonnes per annum by FY28.

articles.title: Target reports strongest quarterly sales gain in five years heading into the holiday shopping season
articles.desc: Target reported a 7.1% increase in net sales for the third quarter, reaching $27.07 billion. The growth was attributed to a revitalized product lineup, expanded same-day deliveries, and price cuts. CEO Michael Fiddelke indicated that the sales momentum was observed across various income groups. The company aims to enhance clothing and home goods offerings while working on women's apparel and footwear.

articles.title: India on track to hit $1 trillion exports target in FY27: Commerce Secretary
articles.desc: India's exports increased by 16.6% in the first half of this fiscal year. The country aims to reach $1 trillion in exports by 2026-27. Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal stated that India is on track to meet this goal. Despite global trade uncertainties, India continues to be viewed positively as a trusted trading partner. India achieved record exports of $863 billion in the previous fiscal year.

articles.title: Nasdaq gains in choppy trade as Nvidia outlook lifts AI mood; Anthropic pricing awaited
articles.desc: Amidst a choppy trading session, the Nasdaq enjoyed a boost from Nvidia's positive revenue guidance, which alleviated some market apprehensions. Conversely, the Dow Jones Industrial Average and S&P 500 stumbled, affected by falling stock values in finance and healthcare. Investors are now focused on Anthropic's upcoming IPO, which could signal the market’s enthusiasm for AI ventures.

articles.title: Trump administration weighs forcing US firms to disclose Chinese AI use
articles.desc: The Treasury Department and the White House Office of Science and Technology Policy (OSTP) have discussed the plan, which would apply to companies such as Airbnb, the people said. The company uses Qwen, an AI model made by China's Alibaba , to power its AI customer service agent.

articles.title: PSBs' net profit rises 17% to Rs 1.10 lakh cr in H1 FY27; business crosses Rs 300 lakh crore
articles.desc: Public sector banks in India have reported a remarkable 16.9 percent rise in net profits during the first half of this fiscal year, reflecting a thriving financial environment. With total business reaching Rs 301.6 lakh crore, and a notable drop in the gross non-performing assets ratio to an unprecedented 1.69 percent, the banks are demonstrating improved stability.

articles.title: Puravankara launches Purva Cityspire in Kochi with ₹2,000 crore GDV
articles.desc: Puravankara Limited proudly presents Purva Cityspire, an ambitious new venture within the Purva City integrated township in Kochi. With an impressive gross development value of ₹2,000 crore, this project features 1,056 luxurious residences strategically designed to promote community living. Remarkably, over half of the area will be dedicated to open spaces, catering to recreational needs.

articles.title: Prestige Group buys 50 pc stake in Advent Convention and Hotels International for Rs 500 cr
articles.desc: Prestige Estates Projects Ltd has successfully acquired a 50% stake in Advent Convention and Hotels International for an estimated Rs 500 crore. This partnership is set to develop a commercial project in Andheri, Mumbai, spanning 21,978.22 square meters, with projected leasable space of 1.50 million square feet. The total project valuation is forecasted at approximately Rs 4,500 crore, marking a significant expansion for Prestige in the Mumbai real estate market.

articles.title: Gateway Distriparks to operate, manage common rail yard terminal at JNPA
articles.desc: Gateway Distriparks Limited has gained a mandate for operating the common rail yard terminal at Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority. This terminal will enhance the handling of container trains and improve the efficiency of cargo movement. The contract spans eight years, focusing on train handling, container stacking, and inter-terminal transfers. Gateway aims to work closely with JNPA to improve rail connectivity for trade.

articles.title: IndoSpace launches 1.05M sq ft Narasapura-II industrial and logistics park in Karnataka
articles.desc: IndoSpace has launched Narasapura-II, an industrial and logistics park in Karnataka with a size of approximately 1.05 million square feet. The company announced an investment of Rs 350 crore to enhance its presence in the region. This park aims to support businesses across various sectors including e-commerce and manufacturing. The location in Narasapura is strategically chosen for its connectivity to Bengaluru's markets.

articles.title: Real estate firm Assetz gets Sebi nod to float Rs 1,200-cr IPO
articles.desc: Assetz Ltd has obtained approval from Sebi to proceed with its plans for an initial public offering. The company aims to raise around Rs 1,200 crore in this IPO process. Assetz has developed a substantial land bank and project pipeline to meet housing demand in Bengaluru. With strong backing from investors like AGP Partners, the firm is expanding its presence in key markets.

articles.title: Kotak MF, BlackRock, others buy stake worth Rs 1,905 cr in Groww
articles.desc: Kotak Mahindra Mutual Fund (MF) led the buying spree, acquiring 2.05 crore shares or a 0.33 per cent stake, for Rs 448.95 crore, making it the biggest buyer in the transaction.

articles.title: India bonds reverse intraday gains to end lower as profit booking takes center stage
articles.desc: Indian government bonds faced a setback as profit-seeking traders reacted to earlier gains, with the benchmark bond yield increasing to 7.2858% compared to the previous closure. The fluctuations in crude prices have influenced the market outlook on the Reserve Bank of India, prompting analysts to predict a potential rate increase in December amidst rising retail inflation.

articles.title: RBI may hike interest rates by 75 basis points by Q2 of next year: Goldman Sachs
articles.desc: The Reserve Bank of India is projected to increase interest rates by 75 basis points by the second quarter of 2027. Analysts predict that headline inflation will remain above 6 percent into early 2027 before gradually decreasing. Despite the monetary tightening, India's GDP growth is expected to moderate to 7.2 percent in 2027. Strong domestic demand and an emerging investment cycle are likely to sustain economic activity.

articles.title: Rupee ends flat after hitting seven-month high as firmer dollar offsets inflows
articles.desc: The Indian rupee closed almost flat after peaking at a seven-month high during early trading on Wednesday. Robust foreign investments in local stocks provided a boost, but a stronger dollar capped further gains. The dollar index rose by 0.2%, reaching its highest since April 2025 due to anticipations of accelerated rate hikes.

articles.title: Onion farmers seek measures to ensure Rs 3,000 per quintal amid surplus production outlook
articles.desc: Maharashtra onion farmers have asked the Centre to ensure prices of at least Rs 3,000 per quintal by expanding export markets and maintaining a stable export policy, as India is expected to have a sizeable surplus in 2025-26. The growers’ body said better export infrastructure, storage, processing and transparent supply data will be critical to prevent price crashes when market arrivals rise.

articles.title: SpiceJet board approves up to Rs 5,500 crore fundraise amid operational challenges; stock hits 5% upper circuit
articles.desc: SpiceJet's board of directors announced a fundraising plan to raise up to Rs 5,500 crore. The airline's shares have surged significantly, hitting the upper circuit for six consecutive sessions. Flight cancellations and operational disruptions have caused significant challenges for SpiceJet in recent days. The airline is focusing on rebuilding capacity and ensuring operational reliability going forward. The fundraising aims to strengthen its financial position and support fleet expansion efforts.

articles.title: Govt planning to expand AB-PMJAY packages for public hospitals from 23 to 112: NHA sources
articles.desc: The National Health Authority has proposed expanding health benefit packages reserved for government hospitals under Ayushman Bharat from 23 to 112, adding 89 treatments and procedures. The move aims to improve access to healthcare closer to beneficiaries' homes and channel more reimbursements into strengthening public hospital infrastructure and services.

articles.title: Indian economic growth seen at annual 7.6% in July-September quarter, economists say
articles.desc: India's economy is predicted to grow by 7.6% in the July-September quarter according to economists. Consumer demand has shown resilience, mitigating the effects of rising inflation pressures. Predictions indicate continued strength from passenger vehicle sales and bank credit growth. Despite potential slowdowns in the second half of the fiscal year, investments are expected to improve. The Reserve Bank of India may raise rates as economic conditions evolve.

articles.title: Govt weighs tax tweaks to boost stock trading, curb derivatives: Report
articles.desc: The government is reviewing proposals to cut securities transaction tax on cash equities by 50% while raising levies on derivatives to curb speculative trading and encourage broader market participation. Officials are also considering a reduction in long-term capital gains tax. The recommendations will be presented to Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman ahead of Budget 2027.

articles.title: How Ashish Kacholia, Radhakishan Damani, Madhusudan Kela and other ace investors reshuffled their portfolios in Q2

Meanwhile, Radhakishan Damani records the steepest decline. The analysis examines their portfolio values, top stock holdings and changes in shareholding across listed companies.

articles.title: 16 microcap stocks surge up to 390% in CY26, emerge as multibaggers
articles.desc: The Nifty Microcap 250 has outperformed the benchmark Nifty 50 in CY26, with several constituents delivering multibagger returns. Sixteen microcap stocks have more than doubled investors' wealth so far this year, led by Sigma Advanced Systems, while nearly 50 stocks in the index have gained over 50%.

articles.title: India bonds rise tracking easing crude oil, US Treasury yields
articles.desc: The Indian bond market is experiencing a positive shift, with bond yields decreasing as oil prices and Treasury yields fall. The 2036 benchmark bond yield is now at 7.2393%, reflecting a minor drop. Additionally, crude oil prices have plummeted more than 20% since their October peaks, providing a temporary buffer against inflation.

articles.desc: Foreign investors have poured a record $9.61 billion into Indian equities so far in November, marking a sharp reversal after months of selling.
